name: zc_streaming_floor

tests.name: the Dog was actually AT each stop when residency was read

detail.note: residency is measured around the player. A stop where the Dog died and respawned at the Arrival Gate reports the always-loaded set under a distant stop's name, and would read as a beautifully low floor.

tests.name: residency was allowed to settle before it was read

detail.note: two consecutive counts two seconds apart agreeing within one per cent. Without this a distant stop is read while its cells are still arriving and the world looks emptier than it is -- which is how two different places came back identical to the instance.

tests.name: the world does not keep most of itself resident

detail.note: instances, not actors: the actors that stay resident are mostly small ones, and the heavy instanced content is what a frame actually pays for.
